title: Night Safety Voice Alarm for Dark Village Streets
title_te: చీకటి వీధుల కోసం రాత్రి భద్రత వాయిస్ అలారం
problem: My older sister feels frightened walking home from tuition classes along dark village lanes where streetlights don't work.
idea: A voice alarm that listens for a shout like "Help!" or "Kapadandi!" and plays a very loud siren so people nearby come running. Here you can tap what the microphone hears.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What does the microphone hear?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine Audio listens to the sound. Here, tap the sound to see what the alarm does.
widgets.question: The alarm hears this sound:

options.label: "Help! Help!"
options.result: Danger shout heard! LOUD SIREN ON. Run towards lights and people.
options.te: సహాయం అరుపు వినిపించింది! సైరన్ మోగుతోంది. వెలుతురు, మనుషులు ఉన్న వైపు పరుగెత్తు.

options.label: "Kapadandi!"
options.result: Telugu help shout heard! LOUD SIREN ON. Call 100 or 112.
options.te: కాపాడండి అరుపు వినిపించింది! సైరన్ మోగుతోంది. 100 లేదా 112 కి ఫోన్ చేయండి.

options.label: Dog barking
options.result: Normal village sound. No siren. Keep walking safely.
options.te: ఇది మామూలు శబ్దం. సైరన్ లేదు. జాగ్రత్తగా నడవండి.

options.label: Quiet street
options.result: All quiet. The alarm keeps listening.

widgets.heading: 📋 Safe Walk Home Rules for Akka

items.title: Walk in a group
items.text: Walk home with friends from the same tuition.
items.te: ట్యూషన్ నుండి స్నేహితులతో కలిసి ఇంటికి నడవండి.

items.title: Carry a torch
items.text: Keep a small torch or phone light on.
items.te: చిన్న టార్చ్ లేదా ఫోన్ లైట్ వెలిగించుకోండి.

items.title: Shout loudly
items.text: If someone troubles you, shout loudly and run to a shop or house with lights.
items.te: ఎవరైనా ఇబ్బంది పెడితే గట్టిగా అరిచి, లైట్ ఉన్న ఇల్లు లేదా దుకాణానికి పరుగెత్తండి.

items.title: Call for help
items.text: Call 100 or 112 for police. Call 181 for the women helpline.

questions.q: Someone is following Akka on a dark lane. What should she do first?
options: Shout loudly and go to a lit house or shop
questions.why: Shouting and going towards people and light is the safest choice.

questions.q: Which number is the women helpline?
questions.why: 181 is the women helpline. 108 is ambulance, 1930 is cyber fraud.

questions.q: Which is the police emergency number?
questions.why: 100 or 112 reaches the police in an emergency.

how: Open teachablemachine.withgoogle.com and choose Audio Project.
Record 'Background Noise' first, then make classes: Help shout, Kapadandi shout, Normal sounds.
Record about 20 samples of each sound with different voices from friends.
Click Train and test it. Then Export and copy the model link.
In Scratch (or PictoBlox), add the ML extension, paste the link and add: when 'Help shout' is heard → play the loud siren sound.
Ask Gemini for short safety tips and add them as a poster in Canva next to the project.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student making a safety alarm for girls walking home at night in a village. Write 5 short safety tips in simple English and simple Telugu. Include the helpline numbers 100/112 (police) and 181 (women helpline). Keep each tip under 12 words.
